title: mut.concept_glitch_aesthetics
mutation_directive: Channel GLITCH AESTHETICS (Rosa Menkman, Beflix, datamoshing tradition) — embracing breakdown, error, compression artifact as THE aesthetic, not the failure of it. Translate: deliberately introduce JPEG-style 8x8 block artifacts in regions of the field, RGB channel separation (chromatic aberration that exceeds tasteful), occasional frame-skip / jitter / scrubbing-ahead bursts, zalgo-like vertical pixel-stretches on impact events, palette quantized to 4-6 colors with visible posterization. The work asserts that error is information.
